Asmaul Husna, which means the most beautiful names; it is used for the 99 Names of Allah, the owner of both heaven and earth, the creator of the universe.The importance of Asmaul Husna is emphasized in the Holy Quran and Hadith in every field. Every believer who has faith in Islam must learn the names of Allah and repeat them continuously. Our Prophet (S.A.W.) wanted these names to be known, to be quoted and to be felt with contemplation at any moment. Whoever memorize the names of Allah by understanding is heralded with paradise. With the Asmaul Husna application you can read names of Allah with its readings, short meanings, long explanations. Also you can dhikr names of Allah and test yourself with Arabic Asmaul Husna quiz. The importance of Asmaul Husna is stated in verses and hadiths:

“And to Allah belong the best names, so invoke Him by them.” (Al-A'raf, 180)

“Allah has 99 names. Whoever memorizes them (believes in them and reads them by heart) enters Paradise.”  (Tirmidhi, Daawat 82)

-Asmaul Husna Meanings
With the Asmaul Husna application 99 Names of Allah can be learned with Arabic reading, short meanings, long explanations. You can bookmark the names of Allah you want to read later in the application to your favorites. Texts are enhanced with high contrast and resizable fonts to provide a comfortable reading experience.

-Asmaul Husna Dhikr
It is very easy to dhikr for the 99 Names of Allah with the smart tasbih in the Asmaul Husna application. Tasbih counter offers accessibility options such as audible and vibrating alerts, as well as useful features such as initial value and counter target settings. You can select the counter target as Asmaul Husna Dhikr Numbers (according to the abjad values) or you can perform a free Asmaul Husna tasbih.

-Asmaul Husna Quiz Game
We developed the quiz in game format, 99 Names of Allah are ranked in a mixed order with the meanings of Asmaul Husna. Depending on the matching of the name and the meaning, you must answer true or false each time. Thus, you can learn the meaning and pronunciation of the 99 names of Allah and you can test your knowledge. 

Asmaul Husna application provides language support for English, Indonesian (99 Nama Allah), Turkish (Allah'ın 99 İsmi), French (99 Noms d'Allah), Russian (99 Имен Аллаха) and Malaysian (99 Nama Allah) languages. Please contact us for more language options and localization.
